scope: My Footprint contextual claims and equivalencies

claims.displayClaim: Estimated percentile of the global population by annual individual carbon footprint
claims.boundary: All greenhouse gases from domestic consumption, public and private investment, and carbon embedded in traded goods and services; emissions split equally within households.
claims.method: Log-linear interpolation between published global distribution thresholds. Values below 1.8 tCO2e are only reported as below the 20th percentile.
claims.limitations: TULIP estimates lifestyle-linked demand from a short questionnaire, while the reference distribution also allocates public and investment emissions. The rank is contextual, not a measured personal inventory.
